summary_en: A compact overview of UK pollution-control law as it stood in the mid-1990s, covering common law, regulatory bodies, environmental protection legislation, waste, water pollution, environmental auditing and the EC rules of the day.
best_for_en: tracing UK environmental-law concepts, superseded legislation and institutional history; checking the 1990s legal context
currentness_note_en: High risk: Brexit, devolution, the environmental permitting regime and the Environment Act 2021 have changed the current framework. Do not rely on this to determine permits, liability, limits or procedures.
better_source_en: For real-world questions, first establish the jurisdiction (England/Wales/Scotland/Northern Ireland), then consult current government legislation and permitting guidance.

summary_en: The classic textbook that places groundwater flow, regional flow systems, hydrochemistry, well hydraulics, contaminant transport, resource evaluation and geotechnical engineering within a single unified framework.
best_for_en: foundational concepts: Darcy flow, regional groundwater flow, advection-dispersion, natural hydrochemical evolution and contaminant hydrogeology
currentness_note_en: The underlying physics and hydrochemistry remain highly reliable; software, site investigation, risk assessment, remediation techniques and regulation must be checked against modern sources.
better_source_en: The Groundwater Project provides a digital preservation of the original and translated versions; it is not a revised edition.

summary_en: An early interdisciplinary collection on petroleum-contaminated soils covering transport modelling, vadose-zone vapour detection, human exposure, public health, microbial degradation, soil vapour extraction, land treatment and underground storage-tank regulation.
best_for_en: understanding petroleum-hydrocarbon contaminated-site terminology, the origins of technical approaches and early case studies
currentness_note_en: Analytical methods, exposure parameters, clean-up thresholds, remediation processes and regulation have been substantially updated; do not adopt design values or standards directly from this book.
better_source_en: Real-world projects should be re-evaluated against a current site conceptual model, risk assessment and verification procedures.

summary_en: A systematic handbook of construction dewatering: excavation dewatering, pumping tests, wellpoints and deep wells, open sump pumping, ejector wells, cut-off walls, ground freezing, grouting, recharge, pumps, piping and electrics, costing and contracts.
best_for_en: comparing construction dewatering options, conventional system design, wellpoint/deep-well/cut-off methods and construction management
currentness_note_en: The basic hydraulics remains useful; for equipment, disposal of contaminated water, approvals, numerical modelling, costing and contracts consult the 2007 third edition and current codes.
better_source_en: 2007: Construction Dewatering and Groundwater Control, 3rd ed.

summary_en: Runs from groundwater inorganic chemistry, sampling and measurement, graphical presentation of data, saline waters, environmental isotopes and rock-water reactions to corrosion and encrustation, with emphasis on turning chemical results into hydrogeological interpretation.
best_for_en: major ions, Piper diagrams, mixing, ion exchange, redox, carbonate equilibria and interpreting salinisation
currentness_note_en: Equilibrium chemistry and the traditional graphical methods remain valid; consult modern sources for sampling QA/QC, trace-level analysis, isotopes, PHREEQC and water-quality standards.
better_source_en: Best used alongside modern hydrochemistry references and PHREEQC documentation.

summary_en: Uses case studies to link drilling, surface and borehole geophysics, pumping tests, hydrochemistry, environmental isotopes, recharge estimation and groundwater-system modelling.
best_for_en: training multi-evidence reasoning in groundwater resource evaluation, and finding case studies by technique
currentness_note_en: Drilling and logging, isotopes, data processing, model calibration and regulation need modern supplements.
better_source_en: The Groundwater Project's resource-evaluation chapters serve as a modern open-access supplement.

summary_en: An engineering-oriented general groundwater reference covering groundwater occurrence, well hydraulics, water wells, water-level responses, quality and pollution, management, models, artificial recharge and seawater intrusion.
best_for_en: quickly looking up traditional formulae, design methods, well hydraulics and resource-management frameworks by engineering problem
currentness_note_en: Computer modelling, understanding of contamination, resource competition and regulation have changed greatly since 1980; the basic well hydraulics remains usable, but consult the third edition or newer sources for modelling and management.
better_source_en: Todd & Mays, Groundwater Hydrology, 3rd ed., Wiley, 2004/2005.

summary_en: A systematic treatment of radioactive waste sources, disposal concepts, geological time, weathering, sorption and radionuclide migration, host rock types, faulting and seismicity, fluid-rock interaction, natural analogues, glaciation and climate, and site selection.
best_for_en: understanding geological barriers, natural analogues, host rock selection and early safety thinking on geological disposal
currentness_note_en: The underlying geoscience remains valid; waste inventories, barrier design, THMC models, safety cases, public participation and regulatory regimes must follow modern standards.
better_source_en: For real siting questions, consult IAEA and current national geological disposal safety-case and regulatory materials.

summary_en: A problem- and example-centred text covering aquifer properties, groundwater flow and well hydraulics, recharge, regional flow, geology, hydrochemistry, contamination, resource management, field methods and models.
best_for_en: learning or revising applied calculation procedures, worked examples and typical hydrogeological problems
currentness_note_en: The 2nd edition's software, field tools, contaminant remediation, standards and management content is clearly dated; the basic problem-solving framework remains valuable.
better_source_en: Fetter & Kreamer, Applied Hydrogeology, 5th ed., Waveland Press, 2022.

summary_en: An in-depth treatment of pore-space structure, Darcy's law, permeability, non-Darcy flow, statistical theory, and miscible and immiscible multiphase displacement, spanning groundwater, petroleum and soil mechanics.
best_for_en: understanding permeability, capillarity, flow equations, multiphase displacement and classic theoretical derivations
currentness_note_en: Modern pore-scale imaging, digital rock physics, computational multiphase flow, upscaling, reactive transport and uncertainty analysis are not covered.
better_source_en: Suitable as a source for mechanisms and classic derivations; not to be used on its own as a modern numerical modelling handbook.

summary_en: Institutional frameworks, interest groups, economic appraisal and case studies of British water supply, sewage and pollution control, water recreation, land drainage and flood alleviation.
best_for_en: historical institutional comparison, multi-objective water planning, stakeholder analysis and pre-1980 British water governance cases
currentness_note_en: High risk: predates the 1989 privatisation, the 1991 legislation, the Environment Agency, modern WRMPs and climate adaptation frameworks. Institutional responsibilities and procedures must not be carried over directly.
better_source_en: For real planning work, consult current materials such as the Environment Agency National Framework for Water Resources 2025.

summary_en: A wide-ranging compilation on hazardous materials regulation, risk, prevention, response planning, spills into water bodies, volatiles, PPE, disposal and landmark incident case histories.
best_for_en: incident history, early response-plan structures and the study of technical evolution
currentness_note_en: Do not use this to select PPE, safety distances, reporting thresholds, monitoring methods or disposal routes; its content predates modern HAZWOPER, ICS and a large body of current regulation.
better_source_en: Field incidents should be handled by trained personnel using the latest SDS, current regulations and the Emergency Response Guidebook.

summary_en: Organised around the water cycle and catchment systems: the global water cycle, precipitation and evapotranspiration, soil water, infiltration, overland flow, groundwater, open channels, snow and ice, flood hydrographs and river regimes.
best_for_en: understanding catchment-systems thinking, disciplinary history and the links between hydrological processes and landforms
currentness_note_en: Observation methods, remote sensing/GIS, distributed models, data assimilation, extreme-value statistics and climate change understanding have been fundamentally updated since.
better_source_en: The current Routledge edition is a historical reprint/digitisation, not a content revision.

summary_en: The classic handbook on pumping-test design, confined/unconfined/leaky aquifers, boundaries, partial penetration, anisotropy, recovery tests and parameter interpretation.
best_for_en: classic analytical methods (Theis, Thiem, Hantush) and field design and interpretation of pumping tests
currentness_note_en: Classic analytical methods remain fundamental; supplement with modern approaches for automated monitoring, numerical inversion, heterogeneity and uncertainty.
better_source_en: 1990 fully revised 2nd edition, ILRI Publication 47, official open PDF.

summary_en: Large comprehensive monograph running from groundwater occurrence, exploration and aquifer testing through recharge, regional groundwater reservoirs, resource evaluation and early simulation models.
best_for_en: the classic framework for regional groundwater resource evaluation, aquifer testing and historical case studies
currentness_note_en: GIS, numerical modelling, calibration, uncertainty, ecological water requirements and regulation are clearly outdated.
better_source_en: Can be paired with the Groundwater Project resource-evaluation chapters and modern modelling guidance.

summary_en: The 1976 printing of the same work as BK-0014, covering pumping-test design, classic aquifer models, boundaries, anisotropy, partial penetration and parameter interpretation.
best_for_en: comparing tables of contents and photo quality across printings; looking up classic pumping-test methods
currentness_note_en: Prefer the fully revised 1990 2nd edition; consult newer sources for modern automated monitoring and inverse methods.
better_source_en: 1990 fully revised 2nd edition, official WUR PDF.

summary_en: USGS classic explaining solute sources in natural waters, mineral equilibria, redox, sampling and analytical quality, major and trace constituents, hydrochemical graphics, and the influence of lithology and human activity.
best_for_en: looking up element sources, likely species, solubility controls, concentration ranges and traditional hydrochemical interpretation
currentness_note_en: Prefer the 3rd edition; even there, use modern sources for trace analysis, sampling protocols, speciation calculations and standards.
better_source_en: USGS Water-Supply Paper 2254, 3rd ed., 1985, official open access.

summary_en: Practical handbook covering desk-study preparation, field instruments, water levels and flows, rainfall and spring flow, pumping tests, hydrochemistry, recharge estimation, field records and reporting.
best_for_en: planning hydrogeological fieldwork, choosing basic measurement methods and organising field data
currentness_note_en: For automatic loggers, GNSS/GIS, tracers, sampling QA/QC, safety and regulation, rely primarily on the 2023 5th edition.
better_source_en: Field Hydrogeology, 5th ed., Wiley, 2023.

summary_en: Groundwater effects on construction, soil and rock masses, slopes, excavations, tunnels, dams and mines, together with site investigation and monitoring, construction dewatering, groundwater exclusion, contamination and engineering case histories.
best_for_en: finding historical case studies and failure mechanisms by engineering problem; not a uniformly structured textbook
currentness_note_en: For real-world design, prefer the 2025 working party report, current standards and modern risk/numerical models.
better_source_en: Engineering Geology of Groundwater in Design and Construction, Geological Society EGSP 31, 2025.

summary_en: Covers water quality, particle removal, distillation, ion exchange, membranes, electrodialysis, UV, instrumentation and control, pure-water storage and distribution, and industrial water applications in pharmaceuticals, electronics, boilers and food.
best_for_en: understanding water-treatment unit processes, early pure-water systems and process comparisons
currentness_note_en: Membranes, on-line monitoring, microbial control, disinfection by-products, pharmacopoeial validation and water-quality limits have all changed; do not carry over its specifications or dosages.
better_source_en: For drinking water, consult current WHO/national standards; for pharmaceutical water, consult current pharmacopoeias and validation guidance.

summary_en: Introductory volume covering plant–soil–water relationships, salinisation, crop response, soil water and groundwater hydraulics.
best_for_en: soil–plant–water fundamentals and salinity problems in land drainage
currentness_note_en: The processes and equations remain durable; for materials and equipment, monitoring, environmental requirements and economic parameters, consult the 2006 edition and current standards.
better_source_en: Drainage Principles and Applications, 3rd ed., WUR, 2006, official PDF.

summary_en: Field drainage theory, well hydraulics, salt leaching, irrigation effects, rainfall–runoff and computational models.
best_for_en: field drainage equations, drainage by wells, salt balance and watershed runoff theory
currentness_note_en: The classic equations remain usable; older-style simulation, equipment and parameters require modern verification.
better_source_en: WUR 2006 3rd edition official PDF.

summary_en: Survey procedures, rainfall and evapotranspiration, groundwater balance, soil hydraulic properties, hydraulic conductivity and pumping tests.
best_for_en: surveys, measurement, parameter acquisition and field testing for land drainage projects
currentness_note_en: Modern instrumentation, remote sensing, data management and QA/QC require up-to-date sources.
better_source_en: WUR 2006 3rd edition official PDF.

summary_en: Design of surface and subsurface drainage systems, dimensioning, operation and maintenance, problem soils, project management and economics.
best_for_en: traditional methods for designing, operating and managing land drainage systems
currentness_note_en: Equipment, materials, environmental requirements and economic parameters must be updated from the newer edition and the standards applicable at the project location.
better_source_en: WUR 2006 3rd edition official PDF.

summary_en: The influence of groundwater on agriculture, industry, cities, drought resilience and social development, with numerous 1980s case studies from Europe, Africa, Asia, the Americas and beyond.
best_for_en: finding global case studies, establishing historical baselines, and comparing groundwater development with its socio-economic impacts
currentness_note_en: All abstraction figures, hydrochemistry, population data, policies, climate information and sustainability conclusions must be re-verified.
better_source_en: Can be read alongside the UNESCO World Water Development Report 2022: Groundwater for comparison.

summary_en: Case studies on thermal energy from groundwater, geothermal aquifers, heat pumps, heat storage and reinjection, mine hydrogeology, open-pit mines, rising groundwater beneath London, dewatering and fractured-media testing.
best_for_en: classic case studies and early field data on low-temperature geothermal energy, mine hydrogeology and engineering groundwater control
currentness_note_en: Heat-pump performance, models, well design, permits, environmental constraints and monitoring methods all require updating.
better_source_en: Real-world design should use modern heat-transport models, pumping-test methods and current permitting guidance.
